reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, I'm not hunting for something new. Lab reports are nice but I'm not going to read one, I just want to know if I'll sleep better.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Nothing on the page says what it does for me, just that it's tested. And $30 is a lot to try when I already have something I like.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews from moms like me saying they slept better, or a cheap trial size I could try without dropping $25 on a full box.
